column1: # Release codenames follow the Enderverse (Orson Scott Card's Ender saga).
# Format: <version-glob><TAB><codename>. '#' and blank lines are ignored.
# The first column is a glob matched against the release version, so a whole
# series can share one name (e.g. 0.8.* covers 0.8.0, 0.8.1, ...) or a single
# version can name itself exactly (e.g. 0.9.2). The release
# a version with no matching row just carries no quoted name.
